Board update

2025 in review

Revenue more than doubled, and customers stayed longer.

  • Larkspur Labs
  • January 2026

Thank the board for the time. The short version: we finished the year at more than twice the quarterly revenue we started with, and churn came down while we grew.

Three asks at the end.

Fourth quarter revenue

$2.6M

in Q4, up from $1.2M in Q1.

Every quarter of 2025 was larger than the one before.

Start with the headline number. Q4 closed at 2.6 million, against 1.2 in the first quarter.

The next slide shows the shape of the year.

Revenue grew every quarter, and fastest in Q4

The step from Q3 to Q4 is the largest of the year: 0.7 million, against 0.3 and 0.4 in the earlier quarters.

Most of that step came from subscriptions, which the mix slide shows.

Customers more than doubled

From 310 to 745 customers in twelve months.

Growth came with better retention, not instead of it.

We ended the year with 745 customers, from 310 at the end of Q1.

What matters is the next slide: they are staying.

Customers are staying, and they are happier

3.2% quarterly churn from 4.1%
51 net promoter score from 38
745 customers at year end from 310

Churn fell from 4.1 to 3.2 percent a quarter. Net promoter score rose from 38 to 51.

Lower churn is a good thing here, so the arrow pointing down is marked as good.

Subscriptions made up 70% of Q4 revenue

Of the 2.6 million in Q4, 1.82 came from subscriptions, 0.52 from services and 0.26 from the marketplace.

2026

Three priorities

Turn to this year. Three things, in the order we will start them.

What we will do in 2026

Launch the EU region

Host European customers' data in Europe.

Hire six engineers

Double the platform team to keep pace with growth.

SOC 2 by June

Finish the audit that larger customers ask for.

One click per priority. EU region first, because several prospects are waiting on it.

Then hiring, then the SOC 2 audit, which we want done by June.

  1. Q1Hiring opensSix engineering roles posted.
